messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] edge-us-east-1 gateway cluster — 502/504 spike detected. 5m error rate = 18.6% (>15% threshold). Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/embeddings. PagerDuty: P1 triggered, paging oncall Sophie. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/internal/edge-errors?range=5m :rotating_light:

Sophie: acked — oncall here, joining. pulling logs and dashboard now. can anyone confirm recent infra or runtime changes to edge-us-east?

Mike: not from infra side in last 30m. no autoscaler events.

Deepak: we had a small runtime patch ~40m ago that tweaked connection pooling for upstream replicas (PR: 0f3a1b2). will look if that correlates.

Sophie: quick smoke: curl against gateway shows intermittent 502/504. sample:
```
$ curl -I https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACT'
HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Timeout
Server: edge-gw
X-Request-Id: r-8f3c
```

Sophie: grabbing edge logs for the timeframe...
```
[2026-03-14T01:22:12Z] edge-gw-12 upstream_timeout path=/v1/generate status=504 rt=1576ms upstream=10.10.2.7:8080
[2026-03-14T01:22:13Z] edge-gw-08 connect_failed path=/v1/embeddings status=502 err="dial tcp 10.10.2.9:8080: connect: connection refused"
[2026-03-14T01:22:14Z] edge-gw-09 upstream_overloaded path=/v1/generate status=502 queue=132
```

Ashley: seeing TCP resets from a subset of upstream hosts (10.10.2.7/9). Could be node OOM or kernel connlimit. I'm looking at host metrics.

Sophie: while Ashley checks hosts, let's reduce blast radius. Proposal: 1) enable fallback routing to healthy model variants 2) increase gateway upstream timeout to 3s 3) apply conservative rate limit on anonymous heavy clients. Any objections?

Deepak: fallback routing good. the pooling change might have reduced max concurrent upstream connections, so dialing timeouts up and routing around affected upstreams makes sense.

Mike: I can toggle traffic routing via control plane now. executing: `rwctl route set-fallback --cluster=edge-us-east-1 --policy=nearest-healthy`

incident-bot: Command accepted. Started rollout of fallback routing to 30% of edge nodes.

Sophie: applying upstream timeout bump on edge-proxies: `rwctl gateway set-config edge-us-east-1 --upstream-timeout=3000`

incident-bot: Completed config apply on 85% of edge nodes.

Lisa: support — getting multiple customer reports: ACME (high volume), NovaAI, Flux Labs. Tickets created: #6742 #6743 #6744. Estimated impacted requests: ~12k in last 5m. CS notified.

Ashley: host metrics: two upstream hosts showed abrupt fd exhaustion and restarting processes ~01:20–01:25Z. I'm remediating by cordoning and restarting service on 10.10.2.7 and 10.10.2.9.

Sophie: cordon + restart is good. removing those from LB pool. Mike — can you temporarily mark them unhealthy?

Mike: marking 10.10.2.7/9 unhealthy in pool.

Deepak: confirmed connection pool config in runtime PR limits max_idle=50 -> was applied cluster-wide. if traffic burst + lower pool size = upstream churning. adding fallback + removing unhealthy hosts should get error rates down. will revert that change in a controlled rollout after triage.

Sophie: live metric check — errors trending down: 18.6% -> 7.1% after fallbacks/timeouts/cordon. still seeing occasional 502s (mostly long-running generate requests).

incident-bot: Alert: edge-us-east-1 error rate reduced to 6.9% (5m). Severity auto-updated to P2 due to reduced customer impact.

Lisa: customer CS update: we sent interim notice to top 10 impacted customers and created post-incident support queue.

Sophie: next steps: Deepak to own root cause and PR revert plan; Ashley to complete host remediation and run load test; Mike to monitor routing rollback safety; Lisa to track customer comms. I'll hand off to Deepak for sustained follow-up in next shift.

Deepak: taking oncall handoff for follow-up. I'll open an incident ticket and link logs/PRs. Thoughts on RCA hypothesis: pool size reduction + surge -> upstream fd exhaustion -> 502/504 spike.

Sophie: agree. please list action items in the ticket and schedule postmortem. Also capture timeline and affected customers.

PagerDuty: Sophie acknowledged at 1835123460. Incident acknowledged.

incident-bot: Stabilization check in 10m. If error rate stays <5% for 15m, we'll auto-resolve alert.

Deepak: opened issue INC-2026 with logs and PR refs. assigning to eng-runtime and eng-infra. Link: https://tracker.redwood/INC-2026

Ashley: hosts healthy after restart, fd counts back to normal. running 10m soak.

Sophie: thanks all. handing off. if anything spikes again ping in #incidents and call oncall.

incident-bot: Monitoring — current 5m error rate 4.2%. Auto-resolve pending. :white_check_mark:

Sophie: closing my active page. please keep the ticket updated and schedule postmortem within 48h. :memo:

Deepak: will follow up with PR revert and load test plan.

Lisa: I’ll compile customer impact summary for the postmortem.

incident-bot: Alert resolved at 1835124148. Resolution note: fallback routing + upstream timeout bump + host remediation reduced error rate to <5% and mitigated customer impact.

Sophie: end of thread.
